name: WGBS / RRBS Methylation
overview: 全基因组亚硫酸氢盐测序（WGBS）或简化代表性亚硫酸氢盐测序（RRBS）数据分析流程，涵盖比对、甲基化 calling 和差异甲基化区域鉴定。

steps.name: 质控 + 修剪
steps.notes: WGBS 适配器修剪需加 --clip_R1 和 --clip_R2 去除亚硫酸氢盐转换引入的末端碱基偏倚。RRBS 需 --rrbs 参数。
steps.notesEn: WGBS adapter trimming requires --clip_R1 and --clip_R2 to remove end-bias from bisulfite conversion. RRBS requires --rrbs flag.

steps.name: 亚硫酸氢盐比对
steps.notes: Bismark 将基因组和读段都 C→T 转换后进行比对。双端比对效率通常 > 70%。也可选择 BWA-Meth 或 BS-Seeker2。
steps.notesEn: Bismark converts both genome and reads C→T before alignment. PE alignment rate typically >70%. Alternatives: BWA-Meth or BS-Seeker2.

steps.name: 去重
steps.notes: WGBS 高重复率（通常 10-20%）是正常的，因为基因组 CpG 位点有限。
steps.notesEn: WGBS high duplication rate (typically 10-20%) is normal due to limited CpG sites in the genome.

steps.name: 甲基化提取
steps.description: 提取每个 CpG 的甲基化状态
steps.notes: 生成 coverage 文件和 genome-wide cytosine report。至少需要 5x 覆盖的 CpG 才纳入分析。
steps.notesEn: Produces coverage files and genome-wide cytosine report. At least 5x coverage per CpG required for analysis.

steps.name: 差异甲基化分析
steps.notes: DSS 基于贝叶斯层次模型，对生物学重复和低覆盖位点稳健。DMR 定义：|Δbeta| > 0.2 且 adjusted p < 0.05。
steps.notesEn: DSS uses Bayesian hierarchical model, robust for biological replicates and low-coverage sites. DMR definition: |Δbeta| > 0.2 and adjusted p < 0.05.

steps.name: 注释 + 可视化
steps.description: DMR 基因组注释 + 可视化
steps.notes: DMR 关联到 CpG island、shore、shelf、promoter 等区域。Gviz 绘制基因组浏览器视图。
steps.notesEn: Associate DMRs with CpG island, shore, shelf, promoter regions. Gviz for genome browser views.

references.title: DSS: dispersion shrinkage for BS-seq (Wu et al., 2015)

overviewEn: Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing (WGBS) methylation analysis pipeline. Covers QC, alignment (Bismark/BWA-meth), methylation calling, DMR detection, and annotation. Suitable for genome-wide DNA methylation profiling.
